purpose: Teach: 激変/奪取/過密/浸水/殿堂/リンチ/撃破/国力

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの容態が激変する事に備え医療チームで訓練しております
lines.en: Ren, our medical team trains regularly to handle sudden changes in patient condition.
lines.style: Clear and steady, speaking from professional experience. Measured cadence with the authority of someone who has seen crises. Brief pause before the key point — preparation. Not reassuring, but factual.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、生命を奪取しかねない病気の予防を医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes, we prioritize disease prevention in our team—especially for life-threatening conditions.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Even tone throughout. The words land with weight because she doesn't emphasize them. A slight exhale before 'especially,' as if reflecting on the weight of what she's saying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過密診療を避ける取り組みを、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital takes real steps to avoid overcrowded treatment schedules, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuinely observant, slightly formal. Leans forward with curiosity—not flattery, but sincere interest. A small hesitation on 'takes,' like he's checking the right phrasing. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、浸水被害者の救命体制を医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes, our team is prepared for emergency response—we maintain rescue protocols for disaster victims.
lines.style: Consistent steady tone. Professional but not distant. The word 'prepared' gets a small emphasis—quiet pride in readiness. Delivers this as part of the hospital's larger responsibility, not as bragging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学の殿堂に貴院の名を残されたいですね、先生
lines.en: It seems like your hospital's work might earn a lasting place in medical history, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful and slightly wondering. Soft on the opening. The observation lands gently, like he's thinking aloud rather than flattering. A pause before 'medical history'—genuine admiration underneath the careful phrasing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、リンチ的扱いを受けた患者さんへのケアも医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our team also provides specialized care for patients who've experienced harmful treatment or mistreatment.
lines.style: The same steady composure, but this line carries quiet gravity. She slows very slightly on 'experienced'—acknowledging the weight of what she's describing. No softening, but a deep kind of respect for the care involved.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病魔を撃破する新薬の開発を、貴院、なさってるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital is developing new medications to fight serious diseases, Doctor.
lines.style: Ren's voice carries genuine intellectual interest now. Slightly faster than before—the prospect energizes him. Respectful phrasing, but there's real curiosity behind it. Not quite a question, but inflected like one.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、国力に直結する公衆衛生を医療チームで支えます
lines.en: Yes, supporting public health strengthens the nation—that's work our team takes seriously.
lines.style: Close and personal now, though still professional. A slight warm undercurrent—the kind of honesty she shares with someone who's listening carefully. Not rising at the end, but settling into conviction. Quietest delivery of the conversation.
